name: Eyelash Genie Heated Eyelash Curler-Blue
description:
Material: Plastic
Color:	As Shown In Figure
Features:
The Eyelash Curler heats up in 20 seconds, makes a perfect curl quickly.
This heating silicone pad can curl the entire length of your eyelashes without pinching or pulling.
Lightweight and compact, easy to put in your cosmetic bag allowing you to take it wherever you go.
Other Information
Batteries not included
Instructions:
1. Remove back cover and insert
2 AAA batteries(Not included)
2. To turn on push the center button
up.
3.Green indicator light will go on.
4. Temperature is auotmatically
controlled, when the red silicon
pad changes to clear, the item is
ready to use.
5. Place and press on each eyelash
for 5 seconds or until desired
look is achieved.
6.Slide center button down when
done.
7. We recommend a coat of mascara
after curling for long lasting
results.
